FN-TB8RI15-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 403
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/17/2025
House Bill 403 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA), by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to develop and operate the
statewide inter-jurisdictional Alabama Criminal Enterprise Database, as provided by this bill,
subject to the availability of funding. This increase in obligations could be offset, in part,
dependent on the amount of civil penalties imposed by the Secretary of ALEA for violations of
rules regarding the database, as provided by this bill.

FN-TB8RI15-4
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 403
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, and Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Public Safety
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/30/2025
House Bill 403 as reported by the Committee on Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Safety
would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA), by an
undetermined amount dependent on the cost to develop and operate the statewide
inter-jurisdictional Alabama Criminal Enterprise Database and comply with the annual reporting
requirements as provided by this bill, subject to the availability of funding. This increase in
obligations could be offset, in part, by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of
civil penalties imposed by the Secretary of ALEA for violations of rules regarding the database,
as provided by this bill.
